def get_participants_and_summary(event_title: str, event_date: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    # Search for the event
    events = search_calendar_events(query=event_title, date=event_date)
    
    if not events:
        raise ValueError("No events found")
    
    # Get the participants and summary of the first event
    participants = events[0].participants
    summary = events[0].description
    
    return participants, summary

# Get the participants and summary of the 'Networking event' on May 26th
participants, summary = get_participants_and_summary(event_title="Networking event", event_date="2024-05-26")

# Print the participants and summary
print("Participants:", participants)
print("Summary:", summary)
